toolsPreview.name: estimate_audit
toolsPreview.description: Before audit crawling, reads robots.txt and a bounded same-host sitemap tree—including namespaced, WordPress, and Yoast-style indexes—then returns page scope plus standard and white-label USDC quotes. Up to 10 pages cost $0.01 standard or $0.02 white-label; each additional page costs $0.001 or $0.002. A payable quote includes the quoteId required by start_paid_audit.

toolsPreview.name: start_paid_audit
toolsPreview.description: Starts the exact robots-aware whole-site scope represented by a current quoteId. If payment is absent, returns an x402 v2 PaymentRequired result. A compatible MCP client retries with _meta['x402/payment']; WebsiteIQ verifies the required payment identifier, settles exact USDC, and returns the existing job on safe replay.

toolsPreview.name: audit_url
toolsPreview.description: Starts the free bounded, robots-compliant audit of one public HTTP(S) page. No account, email, or contact consent is required. One free audit is allowed per requester IP and per target website each day. When payment is available, an abuse-limited call returns the exact sitemap-priced x402 PaymentRequired result and accepts a compatible retry through _meta['x402/payment']; otherwise it returns a quote preview. WebsiteIQ never pays target sites and never bypasses robots.txt.

toolsPreview.name: get_audit_status
toolsPreview.description: Returns the privacy-filtered status of an audit. The access token returned by audit_url is required.

toolsPreview.name: delete_audit
toolsPreview.description: Deletes the retained request metadata, generated report, and delivery record.

toolsPreview.name: list_checks
toolsPreview.description: Returns the current public audit categories and scoring caveat.
